content: Svarasavahi vidusho pi tatha rudho abhiniveshah. (The instinctive clinging to bodily life flows by its own momentum even in the wise).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Svarasavahi vidusho pi tatha rudho abhiniveshah. (The instin...) focuses directly on svarasavahi and vidusho. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on svarasavahi today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper svarasavahi and vidusho in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
